notes.manas-2010:p0787:b001:l004: кара көзүмүн provisionally an emphatic personal presence, here in the flesh; literally black eye. Source formulation is awkward, not an invented second character.
notes.manas-2010:p0787:b001:l005: The water/division image is retained literally; no absent proverbial clause supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0787:b001:l008: атаңдын көрү is a grave-based curse; rendered forcefully, not omitted or softened into a neutral address.
notes.manas-2010:p0787:b001:l022: Plural horse-disembarking subjects straddle l021–023. кыйрап falling/tumbling retained rather than invented injuries.
notes.manas-2010:p0787:b001:l025: арбып-дарбып interpreted as the crowd bustling and surging, from Yudakhin арбы-, with exact epic compound example. Same at l038. https://el-sozduk.kg/арбып/
notes.manas-2010:p0787:b001:l030: боз кисе rendered gray pouch-belt; source places it about the neck for prayer. No correction to the usual waist position, and wearer not explicitly identified.
notes.manas-2010:p0787:b001:l034: Thick forearms and thousand-person heart retained as the parallel bodily images, including repeated forearms.
notes.manas-2010:p0787:b001:l040: Door-sized gleaming teeth physically jut out in the source; not reduced to an ordinary smile or metaphorical anger.
notes.manas-2010:p0788:b001:l002: God striking him is the narrator’s expression for the terrible blood-thirst; down does not assert death, since Manas continues speaking.
notes.manas-2010:p0788:b001:l006: кагылайын devotional endearment rendered through its circling image, not an added ritual action in the narrative.
notes.manas-2010:p0788:b001:l008: телегейи тең abundance/prosperity on every side; same recurring formula at l015 and801:l030, not equality of military numbers.
notes.manas-2010:p0788:b001:l014: буй кылуу put in turmoil/disarray, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/буй/.
notes.manas-2010:p0788:b001:l026: Шоорук эмес read elliptically as beyond Shooruk, linked to the following proposal to attack China; not an assertion Manas is Shooruk.
notes.manas-2010:p0788:b001:l040: көзүн ал retained literally as taking the eyes in the punitive threat. Could be figurative destruction; no unsupported specific mutilation procedure supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0789:b001:l005: кыр тапсаң contextually finding a fault/cause for objection among the companions, not finding a mountain ridge.
notes.manas-2010:p0789:b001:l011: кызыталак insulting filthy, Yudakhin кызы талак under талак; literal etymology daughter divorced, not an act of divorcing one’s own daughter. https://el-sozduk.kg/талак/
notes.manas-2010:p0789:b001:l019: Speech markers and shifting implied speakers retained; subject of they said is contextual, not independently identified.
notes.manas-2010:p0789:b001:l024: Camping along the river retained despite awkward fit among vows of courage; no emendation to a martial action.
notes.manas-2010:p0789:b001:l027: кара жолтой has the ominous/ill-fated epic sense here, not lucky. Same at803:l031.
notes.manas-2010:p0789:b001:l030: кылым contextually peoples/world of peoples; not always a precise century unit.
notes.manas-2010:p0789:b001:l035: бүлөө whet/sharpen retained as the repeated metaphor for hardening champions’ resolve, also l039.
notes.manas-2010:p0790:b001:l003: Chewing wheat flour and holding the Quran retained as the printed oath actions; not changed to bread or omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p0790:b001:l015: чап олоң rear saddle girth; куюшкан next line crupper. Distinct tack items retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0790:b001:l022: Right shoulder retained as printed; no silent correction to both shoulders.
notes.manas-2010:p0790:b001:l031: сан кол vast army, epic multitude language without invented exact census.
notes.manas-2010:p0791:b001:l001: Ачык айтпай explicitly says not speaking aloud; next quotation treated as unvoiced thought, not changed to aloud.
notes.manas-2010:p0791:b001:l016: Кара Төлөг retained as diviner’s proper name Kara Tölög; title translated.
notes.manas-2010:p0791:b001:l020: аркалуу spiritual support interpreted from the epic guardian context, not merely having a physical back.
notes.manas-2010:p0791:b001:l022: Олуят чалдын эр Бакай has awkward genitive; saintly elder Bakay is the contextual reading, without inventing a father.
notes.manas-2010:p0791:b001:l027: Күйүтү кымбат literally costly grief; strong/heavy grief may be intended. Qualified wording retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0791:b001:l028: Past/completed forms of victory and marriage in l028–031 retained as the diviner’s prediction presented as accomplished, before the battle occurs.
notes.manas-2010:p0791:b001:l037: Six months retained here;796:l017 says six days. No numerical harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0792:b001:l014: чердүү thicket-covered terrain; pathfinding context, not sorrowful land.
notes.manas-2010:p0792:b001:l031: Angular and cornered haze through l033 retained as an uncertain landscape description, without supplied buildings or mountains.
notes.manas-2010:p0792:b001:l035: керүү upland/ridge provisionally; no modern site identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0792:b001:l038: бөөт-бөөт scattered/separate patches, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бөөт/; same with passes793:l041.
notes.manas-2010:p0792:b001:l041: бөрсө = kangaroo, explicitly in this edition glossary1836:b001:l008. Glossary identification retained without asserting zoological geography.
notes.manas-2010:p0793:b001:l004: Adam-Barbas is the source place-name; English Where No Man Goes supplies its transparent meaning.
notes.manas-2010:p0793:b001:l008: Barking lizards and the wingless camel-sized bird at l015–016 retained; no modern species invented for the bird.
notes.manas-2010:p0793:b001:l019: каркыбар means mighty/brave one in praise, Yudakhin and2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/каркыбар/. Applied to creatures here as printed; not treated as another animal species.
notes.manas-2010:p0793:b001:l027: бука кийик and төө кийик translated descriptively as wild bull-/camel-beasts; specific species not established. жөө кийик at l029 interpreted upright wild creatures in the human-running comparison, not asserted to be a known ape species.
notes.manas-2010:p0793:b001:l028: адырмак hills, Yudakhin and1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/адырмак/; not another creature in the list.
notes.manas-2010:p0793:b001:l038: Horses’ brows brightening retained as the personifying image.
notes.manas-2010:p0794:b001:l005: жойкун trampled swath through vegetation, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/жойкун/.
notes.manas-2010:p0794:b001:l020: Үзгүлтүк provisionally geographical name Üzgültük in the paired geographic clauses; precise referent unestablished.
notes.manas-2010:p0794:b001:l034: эгиз II lofty/high, not twin in this epithet; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/эгиз/.
notes.manas-2010:p0794:b001:l035: Planting a garden and building a house retained as the parallel images for Bakay’s nurturing work, without replacing them by spear combat.
notes.manas-2010:p0794:b001:l037: санжыргалуу honored/authoritative, Yudakhin sense3 and1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/санжыргалуу/.
notes.manas-2010:p0795:b001:l011: Self-deprecating wretched/damned eyes is the contextual speaker reading; the source is grammatically third-person genitive.
notes.manas-2010:p0795:b001:l014: Water rising into eyes and head retained, not silently converted into drunkenness; source specifically says water.
notes.manas-2010:p0795:b001:l029: кайнатылуу шор boiling misery, Yudakhin шор I/II exact boiling-brine/misfortune idioms; https://el-sozduk.kg/шор/. Same at804:l008.
notes.manas-2010:p0795:b001:l030: өмөлүп provisionally hunched/stooping movement of the approaching force; no invented crawling ambush.
notes.manas-2010:p0795:b001:l036: Printed эл people retained despite surrounding landscape description; not emended to жер land.
notes.manas-2010:p0796:b001:l017: Six days as printed, contrasted with six months791:l037.
notes.manas-2010:p0796:b001:l023: бала куш young hawk in the falconry simile; no new named bird.
notes.manas-2010:p0796:b001:l030: Dust expression retained with repetition; it also evokes raising a commotion.
notes.manas-2010:p0796:b001:l037: Loose waist and woman-like/beast-like insults through l042 retained as Bakay’s speech, not endorsed narration or softened.
notes.manas-2010:p0797:b001:l016: Seven-day kingship retained as printed; no replacement with a longer reign.
notes.manas-2010:p0797:b001:l026: Short source line consisting only of forty champions retained as its own verse unit; no padding.
notes.manas-2010:p0797:b001:l028: Their valiant ones, their lions retained in its awkward position after the seizure proposal; no invented subject or omitted line.
notes.manas-2010:p0797:b001:l036: абийириң жабылды provisionally honor sheltered/protected; the expression’s exact force remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0798:b001:l019: каң sound of the whip-blow retained as ringing; knee position at l020 is rider’s contextual position, not invented horse anatomy.
notes.manas-2010:p0798:b001:l022: Printed Караан калган provisionally who served as support; possible textual defect versus expected кылган remains uncorrected.
notes.manas-2010:p0798:b001:l028: ойрон болгон provisionally formidable/devastating as epic epithet, not proof of an injured horse. The relation of this unmounted dun horse, twelve leaders and later ridden Akkula remains narratively uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0798:b001:l029: онжоңдотуп lumbering/heavy movement, not inherently limping; exact horse example in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/онжоңдо/. Unmounted state from бош коштоп retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0798:b001:l030: Two together at l027 and twelve champions here both retained; no arithmetic reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p0798:b001:l037: миңче approximately a thousand, not an exact count.
notes.manas-2010:p0799:b001:l005: Кыйрысын урган provisional literal edges struck; potentially an emphatic destruction idiom, precise formula uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0799:b001:l009: жалаңкыч devouring supernatural being, rendered demon rather than an invented named monster.
notes.manas-2010:p0799:b001:l014: Bride-like bobbing/bowing retained as humiliating comparison in the surrender scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0799:b001:l026: Source switches from camels to horses in the repeated surrender description; both retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0799:b001:l028: Forty champions explicitly astonished; subject changes back to the enemy army at l029–031 retained without rewriting.
notes.manas-2010:p0799:b001:l039: Trampling the throne retained as the exaggerated panic image; not silently replaced with a threshold.
notes.manas-2010:p0800:b001:l011: Жөөжелдет proper Zhöözheldet; literally foot executioner, but treated as the named champion in this scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0800:b001:l016: Адамсыз provisionally deprived of human bearing by terror rather than without followers; exact reading uncertain, repeated at l024.
notes.manas-2010:p0800:b001:l022: Exact paired formula билегинен сап кеткен, жүрөгүнөн кап кеткен in Yudakhin сап I: weapon handle falls from hand and heart’s covering comes off through fear. Literal images retained, not diagnosed physical death. https://el-sozduk.kg/сап/
notes.manas-2010:p0801:b001:l005: бил elephant, бадирек fierce/bold or wicked; edition glossary1834:l034 onward gives both senses. Contextual fierce here, hostile accursed at802:l041.
notes.manas-2010:p0801:b001:l009: себил armor/war-gear, edition glossary1842:l024. Eighty-four provisionally equipment count; grammatical possibility of eighty-four equipped persons remains, not reconciled to41 at l041.
notes.manas-2010:p0801:b001:l015: Printed кан khan among watchmen retained; no silent replacement by канча many.
notes.manas-2010:p0801:b001:l022: кара такаат stubborn resistance, functional gloss of the martial expression.
notes.manas-2010:p0801:b001:l033: кара саат brings misfortune/ill will, dictionaries2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/кара%20саат/; not black clock.
notes.manas-2010:p0801:b001:l041: Forty-one retained alongside source40,12 and other surrounding numbers; no missing participant invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0802:b001:l008: Кыркы read as their forty, not fur/appearance; explicit numerical interpretation remains qualified in the singular lion simile.
notes.manas-2010:p0802:b001:l021: кара and бел provisionally shelter/support in the flight context; their concrete shade/ridge meanings remain possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0802:b001:l035: була valuable textiles/finery as booty, not modern synthetic fiber; same cloth-loading image803:l011.
notes.manas-2010:p0802:b001:l038: Women and girls taken as booty retained directly; no consent invented for capture or later marriage demands.
notes.manas-2010:p0803:b001:l002: чунак hostile epic epithet rendered ruthless; not a claim of literal ear injury.
notes.manas-2010:p0803:b001:l013: ар dromedary (Yudakhin ар II=нар I), legs broken by long travel retained as hyperbole rather than omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p0803:b001:l026: укурук catching-pole; no one left even to turn it is the printed total-destruction image, not a precise battle tactic.
notes.manas-2010:p0803:b001:l029: тулга cooking-trivet in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/тулга/. Printed head/trivet image retained with uncertainty; no undocumented torture procedure or confident emendation to туулга helmet.
notes.manas-2010:p0803:b001:l030: жаң-жуң Chinese historical military/governorship rank rendered generals; Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/жаң-жуң/ explains general-governor/army commander. Not a personal name here.
notes.manas-2010:p0803:b001:l040: кожо religious lord/title in Kokand, not a newly identified historical ruler.
notes.manas-2010:p0804:b001:l001: оңдоп салды euphemistic threat dealt with them soundly in the violent context; not repaired them literally.
notes.manas-2010:p0804:b001:l002: ак үйлүү hostage system, not white yurt. Alöökö’s coercive hostage role documented in Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/ак%20үйлүү/.
notes.manas-2010:p0804:b001:l021: Printed жер place retained though a parallel шер lion might be expected; no silent emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0804:b001:l023: өчүңдү has second-person possessive but the context means taking revenge upon Shooruk; qualified object relation, no raw-text correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0804:b001:l039: эшен spiritual master/piety, translated as a religious attribute; not left as unexplained rank.
notes.manas-2010:p0805:b001:l001: бурку kind/type, edition glossary1836:l016. Seventy languages, not a separate people named Burku.
notes.manas-2010:p0805:b001:l012: Керке proper Kerke as Russian khan; no identification with an actual Russian monarch asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0805:b001:l039: Judgment Day at the khan’s doorway and iron doorway to melt retained as speech imagery, not literal construction detail.
notes.manas-2010:p0806:b001:l013: Let him have no regrets provisionally Shooruk’s warning; nearest preceding grammatical subject is forty champions, so reference remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0806:b001:l021: келме profession of Islamic faith; translated, not left as opaque religious vocabulary.
notes.manas-2010:p0806:b001:l026: бото camel calf, not merely adult camel; thimble-mouth and eyes preserve the beauty comparisons without anatomical normalization.
notes.manas-2010:p0806:b001:l027: айча бел slender waist, exact clothing/waist formula in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/айча/.
notes.manas-2010:p0806:b001:l032: Бакчалатып салабыз provisionally turn into garden plots, from бакча and causative formation following diversion of water. This seemingly constructive phrase inside a destruction threat remains uncertain; no dictionary recovery of the exact inflected verb found. Raw preserved, no confident flooding/drowning emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0806:b001:l036: кум fort material literally sand; earthen used as broad contextual gloss, construction not established.
